searchText: "With regard to JWT setup, an idea that came into my mind is that we could standardize the unauthorized error when CL calls the json-rpc endpoint without\wrong a JWT and respond with the file path" Can work in a systemd setup; utterly useless in docker. And in systemd: If there is a common location for jwt, wouldn't it be specified for both CL and EL? If there isn't a common location, responding with the file path might not lead to desired results either. Could, depending on setup and permissions, but no guarantee. All of the popular systemd guides use a common file path for the jwt secret. it's not exactly for either scenario, it's for more casual users who are running EL+CL across two terminal windows Something something "filthy FILTHY hoomans" ... and ok yeah I get it 😄
